verdict.rationale: Clara's AI evidence covers an MCP server that lets an AI assistant inspect or act on Clara data (listing cards, reviewing transactions, locking cards), plus a marketing-level 'CFO agent' for spend insights and 'automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance.' None of it documents an assistant that enforces policy in conversation by chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, or answering pre-spend 'can I expense this?' questions. The MCP server is a developer building block for constructing such an assistant, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens
